feed_title: Velvet Nest Dog Bed, Cushioned Rim, Zipped 30C Washable Cover, Small 46 x 36cm to Large 71 x 58cm | PawLunova Harewood
descriptionHtml:
Velvet. A cushioned rim. 46 × 36cm up to 71 × 58cm.

Harewood is a velvet nest dog bed with a cushioned rim around the resting area, in Small 46 × 36cm, Medium 61 × 46cm and Large 71 × 58cm. The zipped cover washes at 30°C.

Somewhere in your house there is a small bed they never used. Most owners have two. It was cheap and roughly the right shape, and the dog looked at it once.

What normally goes wrong is the edge. A rim has to be soft enough to lie against and defined enough to feel like a boundary. This one is cushioned right round and finished in velvet.

What they get

  • A velvet sleeping surface: Soft at first touch, which is the test they run before committing.
  • A cushioned rim: Padded sides for a dog who leans as they go down.
  • Compact footprints: 46 × 36cm, 61 × 46cm and 71 × 58cm on the outside.
  • A zipped cover: It removes for a 30°C wash, so velvet is not a one-season decision.

Best for: Small dogs, tight corners and flats. These are the smallest footprints in our nest range and that is deliberate.

Why it is worth the money

Small £79, Medium £89, Large £119. Most of that sits in the two surfaces a curled-up dog touches: the velvet they lie on and the padded rim they rest against. A bed cut to the dog rather than the room stops them sliding about inside something too big. Give it 100 nights.

Be clear-eyed about the scale. Our Large is 71 × 58cm outside and the rim takes part of that, so a dog who sleeps flat out on their side will run out of bed.

Size and fit

SizeListed dimensions (cm)
Small46 × 36
Medium61 × 46
Large71 × 58

Those are outside figures and the cushioned rim takes some of them. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Everyday care

Wash the removable cover at 30°C, following the sewn-in label. Air-dry fully before refitting.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

How small is small here?

Our Small is 46 × 36cm outside, the most compact bed we list.

Do I pay for delivery?

Not above £40. Lead times are on the shipping page linked at the end.

Can I pay in instalments?

There is an option. You will see it when you check out.

Will velvet cope with muddy paws?

The cover unzips and goes in at 30°C through a wet winter.

Would an ageing dog get on with it?

A cushioned rim over a soft surface, not firm support. Your vet should advise.

Can I actually wash it?

The removable cover goes in at 30°C, then dries fully.

What if she never settles in it?

It comes back inside the 100 nights and you get every penny.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Pick the footprint that fits their corner and finish it in velvet.
